name: Vodafone Adana Veri Merkezi
notes: Anadolu Agency (Feb 2024) quotes Vodafone Turkiye CEO Engin Aksoy stating Vodafone currently operates 5 data centers in Turkey: 2 in Istanbul and one each in Izmir, Ankara and Adana, i.e. an operating Vodafone data center in Adana. AA's June 2026 country roundup independently lists Adana among provincial cities with one operating data center. No public MW capacity figure found for the Adana facility.

name: Ankara Data Hub (Trendyol x Castle Investments)
developer: Trendyol Group and Castle Investments (UAE), 50:50 partnership
notes: Shareholders' Agreement signed in Dubai 27 May 2025 (Anadolu Agency via Daily Sabah). Project dubbed 'Ankara Data Hub' in the Temelli neighborhood of Ankara: 48 MW total IT capacity, Uptime Tier III certified, ~USD 500m total cost, aimed at hyperscalers/cloud providers/enterprises. Article states construction was already underway; first 9.6 MW planned to launch by Q3 2026. capacity_mw=48 reflects planned total IT capacity.

name: TURKSAT Golbasi Veri Merkezi
developer: TURKSAT (state satellite/telecom operator, Ministry of Transport and Infrastructure)
notes: Transport Minister Abdulkadir Uraloglu announced (AA via TRT Haber, 19 Jul 2026) that the foundation ceremony for TURKSAT Golbasi Veri Merkezi in Golbasi district, Ankara took place 22 July 2026. Facility: ~35,300 m2, 6 system halls, 6,300 m2 white space, 33 MVA installed power capacity (LEED-Gold, Uptime Institute Tier III, TSE 50600), planned as one of Turkey's largest data centers and intended to host public e-Devlet and cloud services. capacity_mw=33 approximates installed power MVA.

name: Turkcell x Google Cloud Ankara Veri Merkezi
notes: AA-sourced country report (Jun 2026) states foundations were laid in Ankara for a Turkcell-Google Cloud data center project comprising three redundant network clusters, total size ~USD 3bn (Turkcell USD 1bn, Google Cloud USD 2bn), expected to reach full capacity by 2028. Reported via regional press (Olay); official project name/capacity in MW not published in sources reviewed.

name: Turk Telekom Ankara Veri Merkezi (Ronesans partnership)
notes: Ronesans Holding company news states a business-partnership (goodwill agreement) was developed for the data center project Turk Telekom plans to build in Ankara. Announced stage; no capacity, cost or construction date published in the source.

name: Turkcell Ankara (Temelli) Veri Merkezi
notes: Anadolu Agency (1 Nov 2019): Turkcell opened its Ankara data center at Ankara Anadolu Organize Sanayi Bolgesi (Temelli), with 44,150 m2 closed area and 12,000 m2 white space - at the time Turkey's largest and the country's first data center generating part of its own power via rooftop/parking solar panels; LEED Gold certified; serves public institutions and international companies. Data Center Map lists 13 data center facilities from 6 operators in Ankara overall.

name: Vodafone Ankara Veri Merkezi (capacity expansion)
notes: Anadolu Agency (Feb 2024) confirms Vodafone operates a data center in Ankara among its 5 Turkish facilities. AA country report (Jun 2026) adds that Vodafone significantly increased its Ankara data center capacity with a EUR 18m investment and plans further growth. No MW figure published for the Ankara facility.

name: KKB Anadolu Veri Merkezi (KKB Ankara Data Center)
developer: KKB Kredi Kayit Burosu (Credit Bureau of Turkey)
notes: Data Center Catalog lists KKB Anadolu Veri Merkezi in Ankara; an engineering portfolio page describes a TIER IV KKB Ankara Datacenter designed on ~45,000 m2 land with ~20,000 m2 closed construction area. Directory-grade sources only; no official capacity or opening date found.

name: KocSistem Ankara Veri Merkezi
notes: Data Center Catalog lists KocSistem Ankara Veri Merkezi as an operating Ankara facility (KocSistem runs data centers serving public and enterprise customers in Ankara). No public capacity details in the directory.

name: TTIDC Ankara (Turk Telekom International Data Center Ankara)
notes: Data Center Catalog lists TTIDC Ankara as an operating colocation facility in Ankara. Directory-grade source; no public capacity or official details found.

name: Ankara Data Center, Module 1
notes: Data Center Catalog lists 'Ankara Data Center, Module 1' as an operating Ankara facility, consistent with the national operator's modular Ankara data center campus. Directory-grade source; no public capacity details.

name: Global Iletisim OSTIM Datacenter
notes: Data Center Catalog lists Global Iletisim OSTIM Datacenter in Ankara's OSTIM industrial district as an operating colocation facility. Directory-grade source; no public capacity details.

name: VeriTeknik Sunucu Merkezi Ankara
notes: Data Center Catalog lists VeriTeknik Sunucu Merkezi Ankara as an operating server/colocation facility in Ankara. Directory-grade source; no public capacity details.

name: Antalya Veri Merkezi (regional operating data center)
notes: Anadolu Agency country report (24 Jun 2026) states one data center is operating in Antalya ('Tekirdag, Trabzon, Isparta, Antalya, Adana, Kayseri, Konya ve Samsun'da birer veri merkezi calisiyor'). The specific operator/facility is not named in sources reviewed; no capacity figure available. evidence_grade=C because the facility identity is unverified.
